Crippling Shot I

Ranger · Level 10 · Ranged Attack

Effect

A crippling shot that deals 50% weapon damage and reduces damage by 20 for 15 seconds and forcefully pushes your opponent out of whatever stance they are in. Must be in Style of Precision form.

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

Must be in Style of Precision form.

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “A crippling shot that deals 50% weapon damage and reduces damage by 20 for 15 seconds and forcefully pushes your opponent from whatever stance they are in” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:crippling-shot-i)

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.

rows.detail_main_html:
Crippling Shot II

Ranger · Level 20 · Ranged Attack

Effect

A crippling shot that deals 50% weapon damage and reduces damage by 39 for 15 seconds and forcefully pushes your opponent out of whatever stance they are in. Must be in Style of Precision form.

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

Must be in Style of Precision form.

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “A crippling shot that deals 50% weapon damage and reduces damage by 39 for 15 seconds and forcefully pushes your opponent from whatever stance they are in” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:crippling-shot-ii)

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.
